Statements.SQL: DELETE FROM "foundry_outbox" WHERE ("foundry_outbox"."id" IN (SELECT "foundry_outbox"."id" AS "value" FROM "foundry_outbox" WHERE ("foundry_outbox"."publish_state" = $1) AND ("foundry_outbox"."published_at" < $2) ORDER BY "foundry_outbox"."published_at" ASC, "foundry_outbox"."id" ASC LIMIT $3)) AND ("foundry_outbox"."publish_state" = $4)
